title: 1881 Haiphong typhoon
text: The 1881 Haiphong typhoon was a devastating typhoon that struck Haiphong, in northern Dai Nam, and the northern part of the Captaincy General of the Philippines on October 8, 1881. The typhoon was first detected east of Southern Luzon on September 27, 1881. The typhoon killed about 3,000 people in total.
